Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} are tireless hunters who split into two distinct lineages: Country @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel}, who favor the wilderness and rural pursuit, and City @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel}, who stalk the urban shadows. Both branches share their parent clan's bestial resilience and independence, applying it wholeheartedly to the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s wars.

Disciplines: Country Gangrel - Animalism, Fortitude, Protean. City Gangrel - Celerity, Obfuscate, Protean.

Advantage: Gangrel antitribu gain one free Animal Ken Ability and one free Survival Ability at character creation, at no additional cost.

Disadvantage: Each frenzy leaves a lasting mark of the Beast - afterward, the Gangrel antitribu gains an animalistic feature alongside a Negative Social Trait (Bestial, Feral, or Repugnant) that cannot be removed except by extraordinary means, up to a maximum of five such Traits.

Organization: Gangrel antitribu tend toward solitary or small-group operation even within packs, valuing self-reliance and survival skill over hierarchy.
